subject: Premium SLA & escalation coverage — proposal request
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quasaranalytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <procurement@quasaranalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:12:00-05:00
Subject: Premium SLA & escalation coverage — proposal request

Hi Aisha / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Quasar were impressed with the runtime performance. We're starting procurement conversations and need a clear proposal for premium SLA and escalation coverage to present to our security & ops stakeholders. High level asks: 
- Uptime guarantee: 99.99% (global) with zonal failover
- P1 (platform down) response: 15 minutes, P2 within 1 hour
- 24/7 weekend on-call escalation for critical incidents (primary + 2nd line)
- Credits calculation for downtime and root-cause timelines
- Option for a 12-month committed usage discount (we'd like to explore a pricing concession tied to a 12-month minimum spend)

Can you provide a short matrix (coverage vs. price) and any proposed addendum language for our legal team? Procurement (cc'd) will expect a DocuSign-ready attachment if we can align.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we are targeting an exec approval by next Thursday.

Best,
Liam
Head of Infrastructure, Quasar Analytics

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quasaranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <procurement@quasaranalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T18:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA & escalation coverage — proposal request

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. I'm attaching an initial SLA addendum draft (see attachment) and a short pricing grid below. Quick notes up front: we can offer the 99.99% uptime band with 15-min P1 response as a premium package, but it requires a 12-month committed spend and a slightly higher retainer for 24/7 escalation coverage. The discount bands are linked to committed spend (monthly average over the term).

Pricing grid (illustrative monthly):
- Standard (99.9%): no retainer, 8 hour P1 window — base price
- Premium A (99.99% + 15-min P1 weekdays): 12-month commit, 10% discount on hosted usage + $7k/mo on-call retainer
- Premium B (99.99% + 15-min P1 24/7): 12-month commit, 18% discount on hosted usage + $18k/mo on-call retainer (includes primary + 2nd line rotation)

Credits: we propose prorated credits tied to severity and mean-time-to-recover (example: 99.99% breach -> 10% monthly credit if MTTR > 4 hours for P1 after mitigation windows). We'll map exact credit math in the addendum.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Ben to propose committed spend tiers (tokens/month) that match your expected usage profile
2) We finalize retainer and credit math, then produce DocuSign-ready addendum for procurement

Ben — can you put together committed tiers by EOD tomorrow? Maya — if there are any procurement constraints (e.g., max retainer or approval layers), flag them and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA_addendum_v1.pdf (SLA addendum draft, 3 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quasaranalytics.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <procurement@quasaranalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA & escalation coverage — proposal request

On Wed, Dec 1, 2026 at 6:03 PM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Pricing grid (illustrative monthly):
> - Premium B (99.99% + 15-min P1 24/7): 12-month commit, 18% discount + $18k/mo retainer

Liam / team — attached below are three committed tiers tied to token consumption and expected throughput. These are the numbers we can sign off on from pricing. If you push for a higher discount we will need a multi-year commit or seat buy-in.

Committed tiers (tokens/month reference):
- Tier 1 (20M tokens/mo avg): 12-month commit -> 12% discount, $9k/mo retainer for 24/7
- Tier 2 (50M tokens/mo avg): 12-month commit -> 18% discount, $18k/mo retainer for 24/7
- Tier 3 (100M+ tokens/mo avg): 12-month commit -> 25% discount, $28k/mo retainer + priority capacity allocation

Notes:
- Retainers cover staffed on-call rotation, post-incident blameless RCA facilitation, and escalation to engineering leads.
- Credits remain as described by Aisha; we'll instrument an SLO dashboard feed for transparent calculations.

If these align, I can turn the Tier 2 numbers into the addendum language.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quasaranalytics.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <procurement@quasaranalytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:35:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA & escalation coverage — proposal request

Aisha / Ben / Liam — looping in Jordan for the technical confirmation on runbook commitments. High level approvals: leadership is comfortable with Tier 2 economics for a strong strategic customer like Quasar, but discount is capped at 20% unless legal approves a 24-month ramp. We should avoid committing to both a large discount and a very low retainer. Also please ensure the addendum includes:
- explicit rollback/feature-flag fallbacks to reduce blast radius
- maximum credit cap per incident (so credits don't exceed monthly invoice by more than 100%)
- a clear on-call escalation matrix with named roles and SLA clocks

Jordan — can you confirm that we can meet the 15-min P1 target with our current escalation roster and what the on-call FTE load looks like for Tier 2?

Respectfully,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quasaranalytics.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <procurement@quasaranalytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:47:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Premium SLA & escalation coverage — proposal request

Vanessa / team — technical confirmation below. We can commit to the 15-minute P1 ack and the 1-hour P2 window for Tier 2 under the following controls:
- Dedicated escalation roster with named primary on-call plus two escalation backups (rotations adjusted to limit FTE overtime)
- Runbook and automated pager triggers tied to latency/availability thresholds; we will instrument synthetic traces per-region
- Canary rollback policy documented in addendum; automatic fallback to regional model variant within 2 minutes for most common failure modes

Operational impact: maintaining 15-min P1 across weekdays and weekends for Tier 2 will require ~1.2 FTEs of on-call (sustained) with access to priority capacity. That is covered by the proposed $18k/mo retainer. Any extended dry-run tests or pre-commitment capacity reservation should be scheduled ahead of contract start.

Liam — if Tier 2 (50M tokens/mo / 18% discount, $18k retainer) works for Quasar I will ask legal to accept the addendum language and Ben can push the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Director, Reliability Engineering, Redwood Inference
